errors.text_span: изброени в азбучен ред спрямо кирилицата
errors.evidence: The countries on the x-axis are not sorted alphabetically. For example, 'Германия' (Germany) and 'Дания' (Denmark) appear after 'Чехия' (Czechia), but their first letters ('Г' and 'Д') precede 'Ч' in the Cyrillic alphabet.
The bar for Czechia (Чехия) reaches approximately 13%, not 10%.
The chart does not contain data for Iceland (Исландия). It contains data for Ireland (Ирландия), which has a value of approximately 24%.
The bar for Switzerland (Швейцария) is approximately 16%, not 13%.

errors.text_span: Най-ниските стойности се наблюдават при Чехия - около 10%, Исландия - около 12%, и Швейцария - около 13%
errors.evidence: This statement inaccurately identifies the countries with the lowest values. While Czechia is low, the description omits Slovenia (~12%) and Denmark (~13%) which have the lowest values, and incorrectly includes Switzerland (~16%).

The bar for Bulgaria (България) reaches approximately 34%, not 32%. Additionally, it is inaccurately listed as one of the highest values, when several other countries (Romania, North Macedonia, Turkey) have higher values.
The bar for North Macedonia (Северна Македония) is significantly higher, at approximately 44%, not 37%.
The bar for Turkey (Турция) is the highest on the chart, reaching approximately 48%, not 45%.

errors.text_span: и са подредени според азбучния ред на името на държавите
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of the earlier incorrect claim that the countries on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically.
